# OpenFour parity (R12d, 2026-11-04): read-only BSC mainnet (chain 56) through the free archive endpoint
# https://bsc-mainnet.public.blastapi.io (eth_getTransactionByHash/Receipt, eth_getCode, eth_getStorageAt, eth_call; eth_getLogs
# answers 429 there: the launch was found by a logsBloom scan of 20000 blocks below 131613804, the only OpenFour launch in
# them) by one-off scripts of the BSC session (not in the repository); every row names its block, so each is re-checkable
# against any archive node. The only witnessed launch: OpenFourCore 0xebe7b6c1089d9f72ad07f34e36d898e44e5e27f3 createToken
# (519ebb10) called directly, preset 1778027615724, quote WBNB 0xbb4cdb9cbd36b01bd1cbaebf2de08d9173bc095c paid natively.
# OFLAUNCH block tx index token preset creator value maxSupply saleAmount raiseAmount initialPrice quoteAsset vault curve
#   trade migrate customData tokenModule requested tokenAmount curveQuote traderQuote lastPrice slippageLimit protocolFee
#   taxFee devFee antiSniperFee totalRaised remainingForSale calldata
#   TokenCreated and the creator's TradeExecuted of the launch receipt, the launch transaction's value and input.
# OFMODULE block role address codeKeccak implementation implementationCodeKeccak
#   Core and Tools: EIP-1967 proxies (implementation slot); token: an EIP-1167 clone of its implementation; the modules
#   are EIP-1967 beacon proxies (their implementations in OFBEACON).
# OFBEACON block role proxy proxyCodeKeccak beacon implementation implementationCodeKeccak implementationCodeLength
#   the module's beacon (EIP-1967 beacon slot) and beacon.implementation() at the block.
# OFSNAP block token initialQuote initialToken currentQuote currentToken remainingForSale totalRaised lastPrice
#   OpenFourTools.getCurveLiquiditySnapshot(token) at the block (its end state).
# OFEXACT block token amount cost pay atPay belowPay
#   Executed by eth_call on the block's end state with a state override (nothing signed or sent; no third-party
#   account): a probe contract (code and balance overridden at 0x00000000000000000000000000000000000d4b02, called from
#   0x...0d4b01) calls Core.buy{value: maxPay}(token, amount, maxPay, 0, "") with maxPay = pay (OK: it received amount
#   tokens and lost pay wei) and pay - 1 (REVERT); cost = floor(K / (T - amount)) - Q with K = initialQuote * initialToken,
#   pay = cost + 2 * floor(cost * 50 / 10000) (protocol and developer fee).
# OFSELL block token amount pay gross received atReceived aboveReceived
#   The same probe: Core.buy as OFEXACT, approve(Core, amount), Core.sell(token, amount, minReceive, 0, "") with
#   minReceive = received (OK: it received exactly that, no token left) and received + 1 (REVERT); gross = Q' -
#   floor(K / (T' + amount)) on the state after the BUY, received = gross - 2 * floor(gross * 50 / 10000).
# OFADMIT block token budget slippageBps payLimit amount pay executed
#   The admission's BUY: pay limit floor(budget * 10000 / (10000 + slippage)), amount the largest whose pay is within it
#   (closed form: the curve quote c the most whose pay fits, amount = T - floor(K / (Q + c + 1)) - 1), then the probe's
#   Core.buy{value: budget}(token, amount, budget, 0, ""): OK when it received amount tokens and lost exactly pay (the rest
#   of the budget refunded).
# OFBUDGET block token budget tokens paid exactInverseTokens
#   The same probe: Core.buyByBudget{value: budget}(token, budget, 1, 0, ""): tokens received and wei paid (pay of
#   those tokens, as OFEXACT), against the exact inverse of the curve for budget * 10000 / 10100; the contract's
#   evaluation gives fewer tokens (1.2e-8 to 1.5e-7 relative in 30 probes, rule unknown): documented, not priced.
# OFGAS block token budget slippageBps amount gasEstimate
#   eth_estimateGas of the OFADMIT BUY sent by 0x...0d4b01 itself (its balance overridden): Core.buy{value: budget}(token,
#   amount, budget, 0, "") on the block's end state; the configured OpenFour BUY gas limit covers each.
# OFFEEROUTER block router implementation implementationCodeKeccak implementationCodeLength protocolFeeBps developerFeePoolBps
#   Core.feeRouter() (an EIP-1967 proxy), its implementation and code, FeeRouter.feeConfig() words 0 and 1 (the fee rates
#   live in its storage; a preset may override them, setPresetFeeConfig).
# OFFEE block preset curveQuote totalFee netQuote antiSniperFee
#   FeeRouter.previewDistribution(preset, curveQuote, [], false, 0), preset-aware: 199 is charged 0 only while each fee
#   floors on its own at 50 bps or less, 200 and 1e18 name the sum. Rows at the pinned block and at a later head.
# SC4 (2026-11-05): the Strategy C input 0.01 BNB as OFADMIT/OFGAS rows at the launch state and five later, distinct
#   states of the same token (OFSNAP rows of those blocks; the curve moved by later BUYs and SELLs: 131608600 with 41.8 %
#   of the sale sold, 131610000, 131615000, 131640000), all executed OK.
